\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is an authentication method?' is '\duallayerbox{All of the above}{None of the above}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ is a sequential segment of the memory location that is allocated for containing some data such as a character string or an...' is '\duallayerbox{buffer}{stack}'.

\item True or False: The correct answer to 'How does a buffer overflow on the stack facilitate running attacker-injected code?' is 'By writing directly to \%eax the address of the code'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A/an \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ is a program that steals your logins \& passwords for instant messaging applications.' is '\duallayerbox{Trojan-Downloader}{Keylogger}'.
